integrity: A complete elementary certificate comprises the 5 high-potential states, their reverse-complement low-potential states, 64 six-mer nonnegative costs, an 18-weight fixed class total, a 41-weight orbit total, and an explicit 44-bit covering word. verify.py checks every finite premise without external dependencies.
scientific_limitations: Exact optimization is for the binary linear reverse-complement factor-covering problem at orders 2, 4, and 6 only; no higher-order, four-letter DNA, circular, multiple-probe, or gapped-factor theorem. The 2013 paper already gives a general optimal algorithm; no novelty is claimed for that algorithm. Historical priority and independent validation remain open.
title: The first binary reverse-complement six-mer covering deficit
